squirrel.services.file.FileService

class squirrel.services.file.FileService.FileService[source]

Bases: object

ensure_table()[source]

Ensure the file table exists (with a unique constraint on file_url, required by the ON CONFLICT clause in record_upload), and that it has the columns every read path in this service and in squirrel.api.routes.files relies on.

Return type:

None

record_upload(file, owner_user_id, workspace_id=None, notebook_id=None)[source]

Persist a record of an uploaded file. On conflict (same file_url), only overwrite workspace_id/notebook_id/source_id when a new value was actually provided, so re-uploading doesn’t blow away existing associations.

Return type:

None

Parameters:

  • file (File)

  • owner_user_id (str | None)

  • workspace_id (str | None)

  • notebook_id (str | None)

rename_file(file_url, owner_user_id, new_name)[source]

Rename a file record by file_url, propagating the new name into any notebook data source whose source_file_url matches so the two tables stay in sync. Ownership is verified first.

Raises:

FileRecordNotFound – if no row is owned by owner_user_id.

Return type:

File

Parameters:

  • file_url (str)

  • owner_user_id (str)

  • new_name (str)

delete_file(file_url, owner_user_id)[source]

Delete a file’s DB record, but only if it’s owned by the caller and not attached to any workspace or notebook.

Return type:

None

Parameters:

  • file_url (str)

  • owner_user_id (str)

is_owned_by(file_url, owner_user_id)[source]

Return True if file_url has a row owned by owner_user_id.

Return type:

bool

Parameters:

  • file_url (str)

  • owner_user_id (str)

list_files(owner_user_id)[source]

Return every file record owned by owner_user_id.

list[File]
